about: The places of data-extraction/places/resolved.json that are an area, not a settlement (GeoNames, geonames.org, CC BY 4.0): id -> [feature class (A land, H water, L region, T terrain), feature code (MTS a mountain range, STM a river ...), name]. Written by scripts/area_places.py from the local places tool's output; read by scripts/record_sources.py.
